title: Social Navigation Links
description: Populate the empty SOCIAL_NAV array in src/data/nav.ts with social media platform links so the footer renders the 'Follow' section.
acceptanceCriteria: SOCIAL_NAV in src/data/nav.ts contains at least 3 social platform entries
Each entry has label and href fields
Footer component renders the social links when SOCIAL_NAV is populated
Links open in new tabs (target='_blank', rel='noopener noreferrer')
verification: Dev server renders footer with 'Follow' section showing social links
context: The SOCIAL_NAV constant in src/data/nav.ts is currently an empty array: `export const SOCIAL_NAV: readonly { label: string; href: string }[] = [];`. The Footer component at src/components/layout/Footer.tsx already has conditional rendering for SOCIAL_NAV (lines 95-115): it checks `SOCIAL_NAV.length > 0` and renders a 'Follow' section with links. Just populate the array with real social media links (Instagram, TikTok, Twitter/X) using placeholder URLs for now (e.g., https://instagram.com/suswears).
